title: Cosmic Golden Egg
description: A surreal collage features a large glowing golden egg at the center casting a shadow. Above it floats a transparent sphere containing a silhouetted figure on a path facing a bright cosmic light surrounded by stars and trees. To the upper left are vibrant pink cosmos flowers with green leaves, upper right shows a metallic cracked humanoid android head against a blue and red background, and lower right displays a cute green dragon-like creature with big eyes.
prompt: Surreal symbolic collage painting featuring a large shiny golden egg at the bottom center, a transparent cosmic orb above it containing a lone silhouette walking toward a bright star with trees and galaxies inside, vibrant pink cosmos flowers in the upper left, a cracked metallic bronze android head with blue lighting in the upper right, and a cute green fantasy dragon creature with big expressive eyes in the lower right corner, dramatic lighting, rich colors, painterly style
